# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for security problems.

Report vulnerabilities privately via GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/NukPuNuk/secure-notes-api/security/advisories/new).
I aim to acknowledge reports within 5 business days.

## Scope

This is a portfolio/demo project. It is not deployed and processes no real data.

- **All data is synthetic.** No real PHI or PII exists in this repository.
- The `demo/vulnerable-changes` pull request contains **intentional** vulnerabilities
  for demonstration and is out of scope.
